intro: The cottage is quiet. Father sleeps. Outside, the Weeping Army drums.
Max is eight. CryMon — Crystal Monsters — sleep inside Capture Crystals.
Father is too sick to stand. His crystal sits on the shelf.
Quillpup is inside it. She will take the CryMon. CryTown does not get to fall.
endingWin: Max stands at the edge of the Grove, the scroll empty in her hands.
The war isn't over. It isn't even close to over.
But for the first time since she left home, she isn't alone in it.
Thank you for playing the CryMon demo.

father.speaker: max
father.text: The Weeping Army is at our gates, father.

father.speaker: max
father.text: They burn what they don't steal. CryTown is already bleeding.

father.speaker: max
father.text: You're too sick to fight them. I know that.

father.speaker: max
father.text: So I'm taking your CryMon. Your Crystal Monster.

father.speaker: max
father.text: It sleeps inside the crystal until someone cracks it open.

father.speaker: father
father.text: Father does not wake. The Capture Crystal is still on the shelf.

fatherAfter.speaker: max
fatherAfter.text: I already took Quillpup. Sleep. I'll do the fighting.

fatherAfter.speaker: father
fatherAfter.text: His breath is thin. He does not answer.

bed.speaker: none
bed.text: Max's empty bed. The CryMon sleep. Cuts close. Specials return.

shelf.speaker: max
shelf.text: This is it. Father's crystal. Quillpup is inside.

shelf.speaker: none
shelf.text: The crystal breaks warm in her hands. Quillpup shakes out onto the floorboards.

shelf.speaker: max
shelf.text: You're coming. CryTown doesn't get to fall.

shelfEmpty.speaker: max
shelfEmpty.text: Dust. The crystal is already open.

doorLocked.speaker: max
doorLocked.text: Not yet. Father's CryMon is still on the shelf.

crate.speaker: max
crate.text: A wrap. He won't miss it.

crate.speaker: none
crate.text: A linen wrap under the lid. You take it.

doorOut.speaker: max
doorOut.text: Night air. I can do this.

doorOut.speaker: none
doorOut.text: Tall grass hides CryMon. Wren west. Pond east. Bram on the path. Calder south.

footsteps.speaker: none
footsteps.text: Footsteps on the path. Someone followed you out.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: You walked out with your father's hound and a crystal in your fist.

masonFight.speaker: max
masonFight.text: South. Past the Weeping Army's camp, to the Grove.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: The Grove is a prison. Nobody walks out of the Grove.

masonFight.speaker: max
masonFight.text: Shinigami is chained there. Locked up for necromancy.

masonFight.speaker: max
masonFight.text: I'm going to free him. He owes me power for it.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: You're eight. You cannot win this war.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: And you cannot bargain with a necromancer.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: Then your CryMon faints here, and you go back inside where it's safe.

masonWin.speaker: none
masonWin.text: Mason spits in the dirt. His CryMon won't rise.

masonWin.speaker: mason
masonWin.text: Go, then. But the camp guards the road south, and the Grove guards itself.

masonWin.speaker: max
masonWin.text: I didn't ask for your blessing.

masonWin.speaker: mason
masonWin.text: You didn't need it. You took it anyway.

wrenFirst.speaker: wren
wrenFirst.text: Too young. Take the salve. Calder camps south.

wrenFirst.speaker: wren
wrenFirst.text: West is Ivo. East is Nell. Keep that hound fed.

wrenBeat.speaker: wren
wrenBeat.text: You beat him. The Weeping Army still wants more of us.

wrenCart.speaker: wren
wrenCart.text: You found their letter. They already knew your name.

wrenHeal.speaker: wren
wrenHeal.text: Cuts bound. Specials return. Keep them fed.

maeFirst.speaker: mae
maeFirst.text: You're Max. I watched you leave the house.

maeFirst.speaker: mae
maeFirst.text: I won't. Take the wrap. Wren heals. I just didn't want the path empty.

maeAgain.speaker: mae
maeAgain.text: I'll be here. South still drums.

ivoFirst.speaker: ivo
ivoFirst.text: Camp took my CryMon. Chew this. Calder sits south.

ivoFirst.speaker: ivo
ivoFirst.text: Don't give him a clean fight.

ivoAgain.speaker: ivo
ivoAgain.text: Hit first. Run if the bat folds you.

nellFirst.speaker: nell
nellFirst.text: Too young. Drink this anyway. Reeds hide a stone.

nellBonus.speaker: nell
nellBonus.text: That moth wasn't yours yesterday. Another salve.

nellAgain.speaker: nell
nellAgain.text: The pond keeps secrets. South still drums.

pikeFirst.speaker: pike
pikeFirst.text: I dropped a moonstone in the east reeds. Don't tell Wren.

pikeHelp.speaker: pike
pikeHelp.text: You found it? Keep the stone. Take this wrap.

pikeDone.speaker: pike
pikeDone.text: The cliffs are just rocks. The war is the scary part.

pikeHint.speaker: pike
pikeHint.text: East of the path. In the tall grass by the water.

herbGone.speaker: max
herbGone.text: A hole where the herb was. Only grit.

gemPike.speaker: max
gemPike.text: Pike's moonstone. He said keep it.

gemWild.speaker: max
gemWild.text: A Capture Crystal. Someone small lost this.

gemGone.speaker: max
gemGone.text: Mud and a frog. The stone is already mine.

stump.speaker: max
stump.text: A wrap jammed in the stump. I take it.

stumpGone.speaker: max
stumpGone.text: Just a stump. Ants. No more cloth.

cart.speaker: none
cart.text: A Weeping Army letter on the wreck. Send the cottage girl south. We need bodies.

calderAfter.speaker: calder
calderAfter.text: South is the Weeping Army's camp. Don't die stupid.

calderFight.speaker: calder
calderFight.text: The camp takes strays. One more won't be missed.

calderWin.speaker: none
calderWin.text: Calder falls. The path south is clear.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: So you're the one who dropped Calder.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: CryTown sends an eight year old into our own camp. Pathetic little rat.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Get back on the road before we feed you to the Grove ourselves.

forestEnter.speaker: max
forestEnter.text: The trees close over the path.

forestEnter.speaker: none
forestEnter.text: Tall grass. Patrols. If they see you, they will come. The path keeps south.

groveEnter.speaker: max
groveEnter.text: The grass dies out. Stone and hush.

groveEnter.speaker: none
groveEnter.text: No tall grass. Something waits on the path.

cathleenSpot.speaker: cathleen
cathleenSpot.text: You walked the path to the door. I am what stands in front of it.

cathleenSpot.speaker: max
cathleenSpot.text: You're a CryMon. Why guard a door?

cathleenSpot.speaker: cathleen
cathleenSpot.text: I am Cathleen. I guard Shinigami's door, and I carry its key.

cathleenAfter.speaker: cathleen
cathleenAfter.text: You stand. The door is unbarred now. The key is yours either way.

cathleenAfter.speaker: max
cathleenAfter.text: The door is enough for now.

cathleenGone.speaker: max
cathleenGone.text: Only the key's cold weight where she stood. The door is open now.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiSpot.text: Three names. Three graves. I keep them while this cage keeps me.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: max
shinigamiSpot.text: I can free you. I need your power for it.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiSpot.text: I don't bargain. I run. Stand aside or don't.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiSpot.text: CryMare will move you either way.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: Shinigami kneels. The CryMare won't rise again.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: Fine. You hit harder than a door should.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: max
shinigamiAfter.text: Give me the power. That was the deal.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: Take the scroll, then. Legendary Reanimation.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: It wakes what's already dead. Human or CryMon. Use it well, or don't.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: I won't be here to care.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: Shinigami turns to fog before she can answer.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: The Grove is quiet where he stood.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: Her father. The scroll. This is why she came.

shinigamiDone.speaker: none
shinigamiDone.text: The grass where he stood doesn't remember him.

soldierSpot.speaker: none
soldierSpot.text: A Weeping Army scout spots you. Out of the way, rat. This wood is ours.

soldierAfter.speaker: none
soldierAfter.text: The soldier sits. Go. Before I change my mind.

soldierDone.speaker: none
soldierDone.text: They already lost. They will not rise.

bramOpen.speaker: bram
bramOpen.text: Marks for moss, wraps, stones. Buy or sell.

bramOpen.speaker: max
bramOpen.text: I have cuts. I need stones.

anneGift.speaker: anne
anneGift.text: Take these. Five crystals. Don't waste them on the first moth.

anneGift.speaker: none
anneGift.text: Anne presses five Capture Crystals into Max's palm. Xtals +5.

anneAgain.speaker: anne
anneAgain.text: Don't lose those. Calder is still south.

anneReturn.speaker: anne
anneReturn.text: Max. I hoped I wouldn't have to find you again.

anneReturn.speaker: anne
anneReturn.text: Your father. While you were fighting Cathleen. His breath just stopped.

anneReturn.speaker: max
anneReturn.text: No. No, he was sleeping. He was just sleeping.

anneReturn.speaker: anne
anneReturn.text: I'm sorry, Max. I didn't want you to hear it from anyone else.

anneReturn.speaker: max
anneReturn.text: Shinigami is a necromancer. If anyone can undo this, it's him.

choiceFather.speaker: none
choiceFather.text: Max unrolls the scroll over her father's still chest.

choiceFather.speaker: father
choiceFather.text: His eyes open. He doesn't understand yet. Neither does she, not really.

choiceFather.speaker: max
choiceFather.text: Whatever happens now, we face it together.

choiceHeavenfall.speaker: none
choiceHeavenfall.text: Max unrolls the scroll over ground no one has dug in a thousand years.

choiceHeavenfall.speaker: heavenfall
choiceHeavenfall.text: The sky cracks. Something ancient and enormous opens its eyes.

choiceHeavenfall.speaker: max
choiceHeavenfall.text: Heavenfall is awake. The Weeping Army doesn't know yet what's coming.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: A Weeping Army sentry blocks the rocks.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: Nothing up here but wind and a dead man's CryMon.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: We burn the fields so CryTown starves before it fights back.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: We're winning. That's all we are.

sentryWin.speaker: none
sentryWin.text: The sentry goes down hard. The cliffs are quiet.

conscriptSpot.speaker: conscript
conscriptSpot.text: Don't. Please. They'll whip me if I let you past.

conscriptSpot.speaker: conscript
conscriptSpot.text: They took my village first. Then they took me.

conscriptSpot.speaker: max
conscriptSpot.text: I'm sorry. I still have to fight you.

conscriptWin.speaker: none
conscriptWin.text: The conscript slumps, almost relieved to lose.

enforcerSpot.speaker: enforcer
enforcerSpot.text: Another rat from CryTown. Good. I was bored.

enforcerSpot.speaker: max
enforcerSpot.text: I don't want to fight you.

enforcerSpot.speaker: enforcer
enforcerSpot.text: Nobody ever does. That's why it's fun.

enforcerWin.speaker: none
enforcerWin.text: The enforcer spits teeth and a curse. He doesn't get up.

crossSpot.speaker: cross
crossSpot.text: Warden Cross. The Weeping Army posted me here for a reason.

crossSpot.speaker: cross
crossSpot.text: To guard a weapon. The generals wanted his necromancy.

crossSpot.speaker: cross
crossSpot.text: An army of the dead, if he'd ever cooperated.

crossSpot.speaker: max
crossSpot.text: He didn't. Now he never will.

crossWin.speaker: none
crossWin.text: Cross falls. Whatever he was guarding is already gone.

orenOpen.speaker: oren
orenOpen.text: Marks for whatever survived the ruins. Buy or sell.

orenOpen.speaker: oren
orenOpen.text: The Weeping Army did. I sell what they left behind.

tessaFirst.speaker: tessa
tessaFirst.text: You fought through the sentry? That's more than most manage.

tessaFirst.speaker: tessa
tessaFirst.text: The Weeping Army watches these cliffs for ships. More of them are coming.

tessaFirst.speaker: tessa
tessaFirst.text: Take this. You'll need it more than I will.

tessaFirst.speaker: none
tessaFirst.text: Tessa presses a Greater Crystal into Max's hand.

tessaAgain.speaker: tessa
tessaAgain.text: Still watching the water. Still nothing good out there.

birchFirst.speaker: birch
birchFirst.text: You came from the Grove? Then Shinigami's really gone.

birchFirst.speaker: birch
birchFirst.text: Good. Take this, for surviving him.

birchFirst.speaker: none
birchFirst.text: Birch presses a Sunbalm into Max's hand.

birchAgain.speaker: birch
birchAgain.text: The ruins don't change much. Still standing, I see.

sableFirst.speaker: sable
sableFirst.text: The Weeping Army calls this place dead ground. They're not wrong.

sableFirst.speaker: sable
sableFirst.text: Someone has to remember what stood here before them. Take this.

sableFirst.speaker: none
sableFirst.text: Sable presses a Warroot into Max's palm.

chest.speaker: max
chest.text: A chest wedged between the rocks.

chest.speaker: none
chest.text: Inside: marks, and a handful of supplies.

cottage.speaker: max
cottage.text: The cottage. Father in the bed. My bed. South door leaves.

masonFight2.speaker: mason
masonFight2.text: I trained since Calder fell. Three CryMon this time.

masonWin2.speaker: none
masonWin2.text: Mason kneels. Three down. He has nothing left to prove.
